preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is an integer between 1 and 200 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= K <= N <= 200000 for N, K, a in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N, K, and a satisfy 1 <= K <= N <= 2*10^5 and 1 <= a <= N.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(f)) == K and all(1 <= x <= N for x in f) for f in special_nodes_list)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the list of special nodes contains K distinct integers between 1 and N.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in edges) and len(edges) == N - 1 for edges in edge_lists)
preconditions.description: For each test case, there are exactly N-1 edges, and each edge connects two valid nodes between 1 and N.

preconditions.expression: all(is_tree(N, edges) for N, edges in zip(N_list, edge_lists))
preconditions.description: The graph formed by the edges for each test case is a tree (connected and acyclic).
The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 4*10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly 2 lines for each of the T test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == N for line, N in zip(stdout_lines[::2], N_list))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the first output line contains exactly N space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == N for line, N in zip(stdout_lines[1::2], N_list))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the second output line contains exactly N space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(int(val) == max(d(a, u) - d(b, u) for u in specials) for b, val in enumerate(line.split(), 1)) for line, a, specials, tree in zip(stdout_lines[::2], a_list, special_nodes_list, tree_list))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the i-th integer in the first output line equals the maximum value of d(a, u) - d(i, u) over all special nodes u, where d(p, q) is the distance in the tree.

postconditions.expression: all(all(int(val) in specials and (d(a, int(val)) - d(b, int(val)) == max(d(a, u) - d(b, u) for u in specials)) for b, val in enumerate(line.split(), 1)) for line, specials, tree in zip(stdout_lines[1::2], special_nodes_list, tree_list))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the i-th integer in the second output line is a special node u that attains the maximum value of d(a, u) - d(i, u).
